name: Supplies for Sven
summary: In northwestern Duskwood, Sven Yorgen's camp depends on provisions from Darkshire. The Carevin family keeps his small band supplied as they hold their watch against the shadows.

sections.title: A Lifeline for the Camp
sections.body: Sven Yorgen and his few followers keep camp in the northwestern wilderness, far from Darkshire. Their numbers are too small to leave the watch and make the journey into town. So the Carevin family sends food, bandages, and other necessities to help the band hold its ground.

faq.answer: The Carevin family of Darkshire sends these supplies. They arrange provisions for Sven Yorgen and his camp in the wilderness.

faq.q: Why can't Sven fetch his own supplies?
faq.answer: Sven's band has too few people to leave the camp. His surviving companions guard it in northwestern Duskwood against beasts and undead, and none can be spared for the dangerous road to Darkshire.
Sven's camp lies along the northwestern edge of Duskwood, in the hills beyond the Night Watch's direct protection.

Sven Yorgen is a frontiersman and devout believer in the Light who once farmed in Duskwood. After tragedy struck his homestead, he established an armed camp on the frontier to strike back at the dark forces plaguing the region.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see Sven's defiance against Duskwood's darkness as work of the Light. These provisions go to a brother in faith.
With the Night Watch stretched thin defending Darkshire, Alliance travelers often carry supplies to isolated outposts like Sven's camp.
